The Westminster College Department of Mathematics and Computer Science invites applications for a 2-year Visiting Assistant Professor of Computer Science, to begin August 2027. We seek dynamic and innovative teacher-scholars who are committed to excellence in undergraduate education and student-centered learning. Responsibilities include:
<br><br> 1. Teach three courses per semester (in person) in a broad range of courses in the computer science program and the College’s core curriculum.
<br><br> 2. Maintain and expand our current offerings.
<br><br> 3. Maintain an active program of scholarship.
<br><br>
🗓️ Complete applications received by ***October 16, 2026*** will receive full consideration, but applications will be accepted after this date until the position is filled.
